info.name: WAB Admin API
info.description: Generated by `npm run docs`. Do not edit by hand.

request.description: A correct password emails a one-time code to the admin; it does not open a session. Wrong passwords count toward the lockout (429 while locked). Asking again inside `resendAfterSeconds` does not send another code.
The right code opens the session (once). Errors: `OTP_INVALID`, `OTP_EXPIRED` (401), 429 while locked. A wrong code counts toward the same lockout as a wrong password.
Keeps an active session alive. A session idle for longer than `admin.sessionIdleSec` has an expired refresh token (401); reusing an old token ends the session.
Revokes the refresh token. Always succeeds for a well-formed token.
